_notes: Account-schema attributes a Microsoft Entra source needs before 'Manage Microsoft Entra Service Principals as Accounts' aggregates service principals (SailPoint doc 'Service Principal as Accounts Attributes'). The UI adds them when the toggle is switched on; the API does not, so `isc-source.sh schema-spn` (run automatically by configure for the machine-identity profile) adds the missing ones with PATCH /v2026/sources/{id}/schemas/{accountSchemaId}. `schema` names an entitlement schema on the source; the script resolves it to {type, id, name}. Existing attributes are never changed.

attributes.name: objectId
attributes.description: ID of the user, service principal or managed identity (identity attribute)

attributes.name: accountEnabled
attributes.description: Whether the user, service principal or managed identity is enabled

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Address-book description of the user or service principal

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: Address-book display name of the user or service principal

attributes.name: spn_appDisplayName
attributes.description: Display name of the application

attributes.name: spn_app_Description
attributes.description: Application description

attributes.name: spn_appId
attributes.description: Application (client) ID

attributes.name: spn_applicationTemplateId
attributes.description: Application template ID

attributes.name: spn_appOwnerOrganizationId
attributes.description: Tenant ID where the application is registered

attributes.name: spn_createdDateTime
attributes.description: When the application was registered

attributes.name: spn_homepage
attributes.description: Application home page URL

attributes.name: spn_loginUrl
attributes.description: Sign-in redirect URL

attributes.name: spn_logoutUrl
attributes.description: Sign-out URL

attributes.name: spn_servicePrincipalType
attributes.description: Application, ManagedIdentity or Legacy

attributes.name: spn_signInAudience
attributes.description: Microsoft accounts supported by the application

attributes.name: spn_passwordCredentials
attributes.description: Password credentials on the service principal

attributes.name: spn_keyCredentials
attributes.description: Key credentials on the service principal

attributes.name: spn_tags
attributes.description: Tags on the service principal

attributes.name: spn_app_owners
attributes.description: Owners of the application

attributes.name: spn_owner
attributes.description: Owners of the service principal (users, as UPN)

attributes.name: spn_app_passwordCredentials
attributes.description: Password credentials on the application

attributes.name: spn_app_keyCredentials
attributes.description: Key credentials on the application

attributes.name: spn_appRoles
attributes.description: App roles exposed by the application

attributes.name: appRoleAssignments
attributes.description: Application roles assigned to the account

attributes.name: groups
attributes.description: Groups of the user, service principal or managed identity

attributes.name: roles
attributes.description: Microsoft Entra roles of the account

attributes.name: azureRoleAssignments
attributes.description: Azure RBAC role assignments

attributes.name: spn_adminConsentedPermissions
attributes.description: Admin-consented permissions of the service principal

attributes.name: spn_userConsentedPermissions
attributes.description: User-consented permissions of the service principal
